study_system.scientific_role: fresh independent stress test of the two-layer EOG-WF architecture on a source-conditioned ecological spread process

expected_files.name: CovariateData.csv
expected_files.role: non-response grid geometry and habitat/management covariates

expected_files.name: SurveillanceData.csv
expected_files.role: response-bearing rabies surveillance data; rows forbidden at Gate 0

source.transport: public Zenodo individual-file download with checksum verification

public_documentation_basis.response_design: positive and negative rabies surveillance counts by grid ID, season, year and surveillance method
public_documentation_basis.spatial_inputs: CovariateData.csv provides grid ID plus latitude and longitude of each grid-cell centroid
public_documentation_basis.external_comparator_class: published multi-method dynamic occupancy model with method-specific detection and habitat/management effects

process_closure_gate.claim_boundary: EOG will not claim that the three-state grid universe is closed to all rabies introduction from outside. Any forecast is explicitly conditional on realised internal source grids and may be falsified by later positives unsupported by the frozen internal-source world universe.
eligible_only_if: the grid universe has stable machine-readable coordinates
the spatial domain and temporal cadence support a meaningful internal-source propagation claim
external-source uncertainty can be handled by narrowing the claim rather than silently treating the region as closed

two_layer_architecture_freeze.latent_layer: exact frozen rule identities retained for compatibility, sequential contraction and finite-universe falsification
two_layer_architecture_freeze.predictive_layer: symmetric_world_support_summary_v1; arbitrary world IDs are forbidden as supervised predictive features

allowed_at_gate0: full CovariateData.csv because it is declared non-response node/geometry input
SurveillanceData.csv bytes for exact checksum only
exactly the first physical header line of SurveillanceData.csv

pass_if: both published files match frozen MD5 checksums
CovariateData has unique stable grid IDs and finite centroid coordinates
surveillance schema can be identified from its header without reading data rows
response and non-response inputs remain deterministically separable
the conditional internal-source spread interpretation remains defensible
stop_if: grid geometry is ambiguous or duplicated beyond deterministic resolution
basic node/world construction requires response rows
the spatial process cannot support even a conditional internal-source claim

post_gate0_sequence: freeze full response-blind grid geometry and non-response habitat/ORV inputs
construct response-blind structural scale ladder and adequacy certificate
freeze internal-source update semantics and symmetric_world_support_summary_v1
freeze temporal holdout plus published dynamic-occupancy and flexible external comparators
only then open SurveillanceData.csv rows once
no_rescue_rule: If a pre-response scientific gate fails, stop without opening surveillance rows and do not change the gate to force eligibility.
